theorem study_a_abs_product (x y : ℝ) : |x * y| = |x| * |y| :=

    apply abs_eq
  have h2 : |x| * |y| = x * y ∨ |x| * |y| = -x * y := by
    apply abs_mul
  have h3 : x * y = |x * y| ∨ x * y = -|x * y| := by
    apply mul_eq_abs
  have h4 : x = |x| ∨ x = -|x| := by
    apply eq_abs
  have h5 : y = |y| ∨ y = -|y| := by
    apply eq_abs
  have h6 : |x| * |y| = x * y ∨ |x| * |y| = -x * y := by
    by_contra
    have := h2
    linarith

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_a_abs_product (x y : ℝ) : |x * y| = |x| * |y| := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators

theorem study_a_abs_product (x y : ℝ) : |x * y| = |x| * |y| :=
by
  have h1 : |x * y| = x * y ∨ |x * y| = -x * y := by
    apply abs_eq
  have h2 : |x| * |y| = x * y ∨ |x| * |y| = -x * y := by
    apply abs_mul
  have h3 : x * y = |x * y| ∨ x * y = -|x * y| := by
    apply mul_eq_abs
  have h4 : x = |x| ∨ x = -|x| := by
    apply eq_abs
  have h5 : y = |y| ∨ y = -|y| := by
    apply eq_abs
  have h6 : |x| * |y| = |x * y| := by
    by_cases h12 : x * y = |x * y|
    · rw [h12]
      rw [abs_mul]
    · rw [h12]
      rw [mul_neg_neg, abs_mul]
  have h7 : |x * y| = |x| * |y| := by
    by_cases h13 : x * y = |x * y|
    · rw [h13]
      rw [abs_mul]
    · rw [h13]
      rw [mul_neg_neg, abs_mul]
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_a_abs_product = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_a_abs_product := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.study_a_abs_product

open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_dvd_antisymmetry (a b : ℕ) (hab : a ∣ b) (hba : b ∣ a) : a = b
:= by
  have h1 : ∃ k : ℕ, b = a * k := hab
  have h2 : ∃ k : ℕ, a = b * k := hba
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := h2
  have h3 : a * k1 = b := by rw [hk1]
  have h4 : b * k2 = a := by rw [hk2]
  have h5 : a * k1 * k2 = a := by rw [h4, h3]
  have h6 : k1 * k2 = 1 := by
    rw [h5]
    exact nat.mul_right_cancel' a
  have h7 : k1 = 1 := by
    rw [h6]
    exact nat.one_mul k2
  have h8 : k2 = 1 := by
    rw [h6]
    exact nat.mul_left_cancel' b
  rw [h7, h8]
  exact h1.1
  exact h2.1
end Nl2LeanCandidate
